description.summary: session and power control for treeland

protocol.description:
Warning! This protocol is EXPERIMENTAL and under active development. It may change at any time, including in backward-incompatible ways, without incrementing the interface major version and without prior notice. No compatibility guarantees of any kind are provided. Clients and compositors must track the upstream definition in treeland-protocols and must not rely on the current interface names, requests, events, or semantics remaining stable across releases.
This protocol allows a privileged DDE client such as the greeter or shell to trigger session and power actions on the compositor: locking the screen, showing the shutdown and session menu, and switching users.
The compositor should reject bind attempts from non-privileged clients.
The terms "must", "must not", "should", and "may" in this document are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119.

interface.name: treeland_session_control_v1
interface.description:
A global that exposes session and power actions to a privileged DDE client.
The compositor should reject bind attempts from non-privileged clients.
This interface is stateless: each request is an independent one-shot action. The compositor does not send events in response to these requests; clients that need to observe the resulting session state should use the appropriate session or idle protocols instead.

request.name: destroy
request.description:
Destroy the treeland_session_control_v1 object.
This request does not alter any session or power state; the compositor retains whatever state was last requested.

request.name: lock
request.description:
Request that the compositor lock the current session. The compositor may apply the lock asynchronously.
The compositor should ignore this request while a lock screen is already active.

request.name: show_shutdown_menu

description.summary: show the shutdown and session menu

request.description:
Request that the compositor show the shutdown and session menu, letting the user choose a power or session action such as power off, reboot, suspend, hibernate, or log out.
The compositor should ignore this request while a lock screen is already active.

request.name: switch_user
request.description:
Request that the compositor show the user switch UI, letting the user pick another login session to switch to.
The compositor should ignore this request while a lock screen is already active.
